description: Brush calligraphy tracing practice on Rokid glasses: a 20-character library with per-stroke model glyphs (brightest green for the current stroke), spoken stroke tips, write on real paper with a real brush, then a photo check for three coarse items only (missing/extra strokes, balance, the most obvious differences) with the learner's own override, and cross-session progress.
name: Trace Brush
